role: Steam operational and automation domain platform on Campfire
authority: Steam accounts, credential references/generations, sessions, runtime placement, egress, bot affinity, collection policies, Steam-specific operation catalog and effect adapters
maturity: NEW PROPOSAL / NOT IMPLEMENTED / NOT DEPLOYED

findings.title: SteamCloud cannot be production authority until Campfire and Ember qualify
findings.claim: SteamCloud is a new Campfire profile and therefore inherits Campfire C1-C5 and Ember trust/durability blockers.
findings.scenario: The new domain is deployed with real Steam credentials or persistent sessions against reference orchestration.
findings.remediation: Develop against mock agents, but gate real account authority on signed Campfire/Ember qualification evidence.

findings.title: Credential vault and opaque secret lease path are not implemented
findings.claim: The proposed architecture requires Campfire/Ember to hold only references and generations; no production vault integration exists.
findings.scenario: A shortcut stores refresh tokens, passwords, cookies or authenticator secrets in a run, queue or database projection.
findings.remediation: Implement KMS-backed envelope encryption and one-runtime short-lived secret leases with audit and revocation.

findings.title: External account/scraper agents and resource fencing are not implemented
findings.claim: The package contains contracts and samples only; no deployed regional agent gateway, scheduler or egress controller exists.
findings.scenario: Two agents own one account or stale action grants execute after reassignment.
findings.remediation: Implement authenticated agent registration, account/credential/egress resource leases and generation-fenced action settlement.

limitations: Static review of the original frozen repository; no original runtime commands executed.
No production secrets, databases, external services or deployment evidence were available.
Generated sample code is architectural scaffolding, not a drop-in replacement.
